heroHeadline: Seoul Prepares Pressure Campaign to Force Pyongyang Apology Over DMZ Landmine Blast
heroSubtitle: Days after Seoul blamed Pyongyang for a Sept 21 DMZ blast that wounded three South Korean soldiers, North Korea launched a ~700 km ballistic missile from Wonsan. State media says Kim Jong Un oversaw the test of a system with 'wavelike' evasive flight and AI features — claims not independently verified.
footerNote: Data sourced from US/ROK official reports, KCNA, UN panels, IAEA, and institutional analyses. North Korea does not publish national statistics — economic figures are estimates with wide uncertainty ranges.
